{{Quote|Open your glob!|A pirate|<ref name="SC 106" />}}
A '''pirate''' was affiliated with a [[Silvo's pirates|pirate gang]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 106" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the individual attended the [[Trial of Silvo|trial]] of former [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]. After the [[Gender|man]] was allotted equal [[time]] as per the [[Pirate's Code]], the spectator impatiently hurried him, using vulgar vocabulary. A few moments later, the same [[pirate]] expressed a hint of confusion when the defendant asked the audience how long they had been hungry. Ultimately, incumbent Captain [[Brutus]] relaxed the verdict—which originally projected [[death]] by [[airlock]]—but in exchange for having his life spared, Silvo was to lead the way to [[At Attin]], an isolated [[planet]] allegedly providing infinite supplies of [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
The abrasive [[pirate]] was first heard in "[[Zero Friends Again]]," the sixth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 106" /> which was released on [[December 31]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
